subject: The secret feature 90% of users skip (big mistake)
preview_text: You've been scanning single conversations. But the real truth emerges when you connect the dots across weeks or months.
body_paragraphs: Remember that weird text from three weeks ago? The one that made your stomach drop but you brushed off? And then the 'joke' last week that felt a little cruel? And the promise yesterday that sounded identical to the one they broke two months ago? Those aren't isolated incidents. They're a pattern. And patterns are what trap us.

Here's the thing your gut already knows but your heart tries to ignore: toxic people don't reveal themselves in one grand, obvious gesture. They leak it out slowly, in fragments, across time. You catch a whiff of something off, but then they're sweet again, so you doubt your own memory. That's the game. And playing it alone, with just your fading recollection, is how you lose.

This is why I built the Pattern Timeline. It's not just about scanning one screenshot. It's the app's secret weapon. You feed it multiple conversations from different dates. The AI doesn't just analyze each one—it maps the connections. It shows you the escalation of put-downs. The cycle of love-bombing and withdrawal. The slow, steady drip of gaslighting that rewrites your reality. It turns your gut feelings into a visible, undeniable timeline.

Open the app right now. Don't just scan your latest text. Go to the dashboard and tap 'Pattern Timeline.' Upload 3-4 screenshots from the last few months. Let it show you what you've been living through. It will hurt to see it laid bare. But it's the kind of hurt that leads to freedom. P.S. The 800+ users who identified toxic patterns? 94% of them used this feature to finally see the whole picture, not just the pieces.
